title: DIALS Benchmark Report
heading: DIALS benchmark report
build_note: DIALS is a development build, so the version is given as dials.version reports it.
note: dials.scale is run with d_min=auto, so it cuts each dataset at its own estimated resolution limit, where a fit of CC½ falls to 0.3. The resolution, CC½, completeness and multiplicity reported here are for the cut data. Where DIALS applied no cut, all data are kept. In all_results.csv, overall_* holds the statistics of the final data and suggested_d_min_cc_half_fit the limit that was applied.
